tooLoud: Soften the hum — a gentle buzz you feel in your face is enough.
tooShort: Try a longer, slower hum. Let the exhale take its time.
wavy: Keep the hum even, like a bee's steady buzz.
pitchRising: Let the pitch drop to a comfortable low tone.
shortInhale: Take a full, slow breath through the nose before the next hum.
